derived_equalities: for j>=1, h[j]=x[k+j-1] and token phase=(phi_c0+j-1) mod w(a)
for 0<=j<=7, every current word has p[j]=MAGIC[j] with MAGIC=11100101
forbidden_domain_shortcuts: replace v by a single representative of its bit-length cell
choose padding rather than derive it
select or enumerate a new k before identity publication
quantifiers: every legal literal variable index 1..v and each sign is covered when a parent bit is claimed forced
every legal current literal index 1..v_plus and each sign is covered when a current bit is claimed forced
domain.total_input_contract: Every input is either a complete symbolic support-cell record or malformed/missing; the classifier must return exactly one declared branch.

hostile_world_contract.failure_if: The classifier calls the cell FORCED_CONFLICT, omits it, or calls escape admissibility an overlap witness.
hostile_world_contract.future_input_requirement: An independently derived complete support cell and certificate showing no universally forced unequal MAGIC coordinate.

mandatory_regression_worlds.scope: k=15 only; not an induction premise
k=19 retrospective verification only; not an induction premise

non_guarantees: no support cell, residue class, forced coordinate, or escape cell is found in this identity freeze
no classifier result, SAT/UNSAT result, decoder result, overlap result, cover bound, circuit lower bound, or P-versus-NP conclusion
no theorem, proof, novelty, independent-review, or mathematical-result credit
object: C041 canonical-code parent/current symbolic support cells at adjacent half-lengths, projected through the unchanged C048 label interface
qoi: For an explicitly quantified supported cell, determine whether canonical syntax proves a universal unequal coordinate against MAGIC, proves escape admissibility from that local obstruction, remains unresolved, or cannot be checked.

branches.CANNOT_CHECK: Input validity, source identity, domain membership, arithmetic, quantifier coverage, or support cannot be validated; no supported-cell semantic branch is reached.
branches.ESCAPE_ADMISSIBLE: Support is proved and an independently checkable certificate shows that no j in 0..7 is universally forced unequal by this local support/phase obstruction. This is not an overlap witness.
branches.FORCED_CONFLICT: Support is proved and a certificate gives j in 0..7 and bit q such that every legal parent realization has h[j]=q while q differs from MAGIC[j].
branches.UNRESOLVED: The input and support proof are valid, but neither a universal forced-conflict certificate nor an escape-admissibility certificate validates.

total_result_algebra.partition_rule: First validate the input, source identity, domain membership, arithmetic, quantifier coverage, and support proof. Failure at that stage is CANNOT_CHECK. For a valid supported cell, exactly one of FORCED_CONFLICT, ESCAPE_ADMISSIBLE, or UNRESOLVED applies according to the two decisive certificates.
